title: Director of Supply Chain
description:
Who we are:

At Integrated Engineering, our mission is to unlock the thrill of driving for everyone, regardless of technical ability. From the daily commute to the open road, we believe every drive should be something to look forward to.

About the role:

We are looking for someone passionate about powering the world's most thrilling driving experience from the ground up. As Director of Supply Chain, you'll build a high-performing global sourcing organization capable of running low-volume, highly complex parts with premium fit and finish. Drive hardware gross margins and command a multi-facility network to get premium performance parts into our customers' hands faster than anyone else in the industry.

Responsibilities and Essential Duties:

  • Cultivate a high-performing culture rooted in accountability and our core values, using all elements of LMA.
  • Quickly get the right parts to customers in key global markets, providing a high level of on time delivery.
  • Stand behind product quality from the supplier through to the customer's doorstep.
  • Recover backorders quickly and drive down our average backorder duration.
  • Keep supplier, order, and inventory data clean so margin and quality reporting can be trusted.
  • Land every new SKU sourced, tooled, and in stock ahead of critical release dates.
  • Build a global sourcing muscle, locating partners who will run low volume on technically challenging parts with premium fit and finish.
  • Source across a diverse product mix, including but not limited to electronics, castings, heat exchangers, sheet metal assemblies, plastics and composites.
  • Clear supplier-side obstacles so engineering stays on development instead of sourcing problems.
  • Drive hardware gross margin on the cost side, continuously finding ways to improve margins while maintaining customer experience and value.
  • Influence design and tooling decisions across new and existing SKU's with Product Development to drive manufacturability and cost.
  • Improve inventory turns while holding enough stock to support aggressive growth,
  • Serve as the company's champion and lead trainer for Lean principles.
  • Own facilities and warehouse safety, including compliance, training, and incident prevention.
  • Create and maintain a safe, trusting, and inclusive work environment that adheres to best practices and promotes high morale.

Preferred Skills and Competencies:

  • Good attitude at all times and flexible and adaptable to change.
  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or related field.
  • 7+ years leading international supply chain, sourcing, or procurement.
  • 5+ years supervising teams.
  • Direct experience managing Asia-based manufacturing partners.
  • Proven gross margin improvement in a global supply chain environment.
  • Proven track record of driving supplier quality and reducing defect rates.
  • Experience qualifying new suppliers from scratch, including high-mix, low-volume production.
  • Experience sourcing electromechanical or electronic assemblies, including component lifecycle and certification requirements.
  • Multi-site distribution and global fulfillment experience.
  • Working knowledge of customs, tariffs, and trade compliance.
  • Mastery of Kaizen, PDCA, 5S, and waste elimination, with a track record of teaching lean across departments.
  • Highly technical and self-sufficient with data. Builds queries and pulls insight in ERP and BI tools without waiting on anyone. NetSuite, Shopify, and BigQuery preferred.
  • Strong business acumen and financial management skills.

Why Join Integrated Engineering:

  • Develop products that are installed on enthusiast vehicles around the world
  • Work directly with vehicles, prototypes, and testing equipment
  • Collaborate with a passionate team of engineers, technicians, and automotive enthusiasts
  • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, and 401(k) with company match

IE Values and Expected Behaviors:

Team members are expected to support the organization's vision and culture by following the employee handbook and exemplifying the company's core values:

  • Can-do Attitude: We show grit and perseverance. We lean into every challenge and get it done.
  • Fearlessness: We're bold and unafraid to fail. We take risks and revel in crushing competitors.
  • Mastery of Craft: We strive to be the best at what we do. We continually learn and hone our skills.
  • Next-Level CX: We sweat the details and prioritize customers in everything we do.
  • Greater Good: We think bigger than ourselves. We act with respect and make smart, long-term decisions.

title: Retail Parts Pro
description:

Professional level sales position capable of supporting advanced functions of the DIY business. The role has expert knowledge of store systems, advanced automotive system knowledge and part knowledge. This role has the ability for advanced identification, trouble shooting and project assistance for DIY customers. The role has the ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. 3-5 years of prior automotive parts experience
Proven sales ability with past experience in fulfillment of customer transactions
Education

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

Previous retail and Key Holder/Leadership experience a MUST

title: IT Service Delivery Lead – Workplace Technology
description:
Job Description

Apply by September 18th

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.

Curitiba - PR

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

All about the role:

For more than one hundred years now, the Electrolux Group has been working towards shaping living for the better, developing and manufacturing products to answer people's needs regarding taste, care, and wellbeing. The Electrolux Tech teams have the mission of creating solutions optimized for the future of the business, delivering outstanding experiences through the use of traditional and new technologies. It's their proactive work that allows the Electrolux Group to keep going on the forefront of innovation within the consumer journey.

What you'll do:

This role is a targeted risk-mitigation position designed to strengthen operational resilience across Workplace Technology. The role combines hands-on engineering, security/compliance execution and backup responsibility across critical services. It ensures continuity across Endpoint Engineering, Security, Collaboration (Teams & Voice), RFS and Asset Management while reducing dependency on key individuals and regions. assigned vendor contracts, asset lifecycle activities and cross-functional projects

In detail, you will:

- Act as active backup (B-role) for Endpoint Engineering

- Support Windows 11, Intune, policy management, patching and configuration

- Offload workload from Team members and support global initiatives

- Own execution of endpoint security baselines (CIS, policies, compliance checks)

- Track vulnerabilities and remediation activities

- Act as backup support for Microsoft Teams and Voice services (telephony, meetings, collaboration features)

- Support configuration and operational stability of Teams environments

- Ensure alignment with global collaboration standards and policies

- Coordinate Workplace Technology asset management and vendor-delivered lifecycle services, including performance and exception follow-up.

- Act as Technology Equipment Services (TES) Coordinator for secure, compliant and sustainable IT equipment disposal.

- Coordinate assigned Workplace Technology projects across stakeholders, suppliers and geographies.

- Maintain milestones, actions, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and status reporting at a level appropriate to the assignment.

As part of the culture of continuous improvement, you will be involved in Lean Thinking projects and activities (EAI – Electrolux Always Improve).

Who you are:

- Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

- Solid expertise in Workplace Technology

- Strong knowledge of ITIL practices, CMDB, governance and controls. ITIL certification is preferred.

- Strong hands-on endpoint engineering skills

- Experience with security/compliance frameworks

- Exposure to Teams and Voice collaboration platforms

- Knowledge of ITIL (RFS, Asset Mgmt)

- Ability to operate across multiple domains

- Advanced English.

Where you'll be:

You will be based at the Curitiba administrative office. Located in Prado Velho, it is a new Electrolux location designed from the start to allow for more efficient, connected and flexible collaboration between Electrolux’s support teams.

In order to create a culture of inclusion and care for everyone's wellbeing, we offer the following benefits:

- Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment;

- Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services;

- Profit share bonus;

- Extended maternity leave (6 months) and paternity leave (4 weeks);

- Insurance policy plan;

- Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path.

As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Scientist I - Quality Control- Microbiology
description:
Scientist I - Quality Control- Microbiology

Position Summary:

  • Shift: Sun- Wed 6am-4pm
  • Location: Madison, WI
  • 100% Onsite

Catalent’s Madison, Wisconsin site is a state‑of‑the‑art biologics development and manufacturing facility supporting customers from research through early‑ and mid‑stage clinical production. Located at 726 Heartland Trail in Madison, the approximately 102,700‑square‑foot GMP facility specializes in mammalian cell line engineering, drug substance biomanufacturing, and biopharmaceutical development, utilizing flexible single‑use systems to enable rapid scale‑up and customization. The site is home to Catalent’s proprietary GPEx® and GPEx® Lightning technologies, which are used to generate high‑yielding mammalian cell lines for biologic therapies, and supports production scales ranging from 50 to 4,000 liters for clinical manufacturing. Following a $45 million expansion announced in 2025, the Madison site has significantly increased capacity, added new equipment, and created approximately 200 highly skilled biohealth jobs, further strengthening its role within Catalent’s global biologics network and Wisconsin’s growing life sciences ecosystem.

We have an opportunity for a Scientist I - Quality Control- Microbiology to join our team. In this role, you will perform cGMP Quality Control testing and ensure accurate documentation. You will operate laboratory equipment, assist in preparing technical documents, and maintain compliance with established procedures. This position involves active participation in team activities and maintaining a clean and organized laboratory environment.

The Role:

  • Independently execute and properly document cGMP Quality Control testing.
  • Operate basic and moderately complex cGMP Quality Control equipment.
  • Assist in authoring technical documents such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and reports.
  • Perform self-review of analytical data for accuracy and consistency with SOPs.
  • Enter data into Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or laboratory reports.
  • Perform general lab housekeeping in adherence to 5S standards.
  • Initiate and assist with records in Trackwise.
  • Accurately complete routine and preventive maintenance on basic to moderately complex equipment.
  • Actively participate in team meetings and training sessions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The Candidate:

  • Master’s Degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry or related life sciences field.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry or related life sciences field with a minimum of 3 years of industry experience.
  • Associate Degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry or related life sciences field with a minimum of 6 years of industry experience.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent with a minimum of 7 years of industry experience.
  • Experience with analytical chemistry and simple and moderately complex lab equipment.
  • Familiarity with clean room procedures, aseptic technique, and general lab equipment.
  • Knowledge of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), or Good Laboratory Practices (GLP).
  • Experience following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • General laboratory equipment experience, including micropipettes.

Preferred Skills & Background

  • Experience with High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) and Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA).

Why You Should Join Catalent

  • Defined career path and annual performance review and feedback process
  • Diverse, inclusive culture
  • Potential for career growth on an expanding team within an organization dedicated to preserving and bettering lives
  • Competitive paid time off plus 8 paid holidays
  • Community engagement and green initiatives
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment
  • Tuition reimbursement

Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career! Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

personal initiative. dynamic pace. meaningful work.

title: Estimator In Training
description:
Company: Gerber Collision & Glass

Great Teams Don’t Happen by Accident

Built with Intent. Driven by YOU.

At the Gerber Collision & Glass, our teams work to provide the elite infrastructure and supportive environment you need to Be the Best and outperform at every touchpoint in collision and glass services. As we continue to grow and lead the industry, we ensure you have the resources and the team behind you to move your career forward.


Ready to grow with a team that’s built for your success? Apply today.


Our Commitment:

The Boyd Group welcomes unique talents from all backgrounds and characteristics. We act with integrity and appreciate the diverse perspectives that make our "Greater Team" exceptional. Qualified individuals, including those with disabilities and Protected Veterans, are encouraged to apply.


Job Description:

The Estimator in Training works closely with our Estimator to learn how to effectively diagnose and prepare all estimates for repair in an accurate, thorough, and profitable manner according to insurance partner and company guidelines. Additionally, the Estimator Apprentice is responsible for communicating the value Gerber provides, resulting in a high closed sales ratio.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistent execution of WOW (Wow Operating Way) plan.

  • Greets customer at repair drop off and builds rapport.

  • Maps damage with customer (previous, current loss, WOW opportunities).

  • Handles repair mapping, takes initial photographs. Uploads photos and notes to CCC One, along with arrival time, etc.

  • Notifies production that vehicle has arrived and places in production queue. Verifies estimate during teardown.

  • Finalizes estimate using proper Repair Planning Template.

  • Works with repair team to make sure notations on windshield are correct and complete. Puts together final parts list.

  • Uses Promise Date Caculator to set promise date. Calls customer to review estimate and promise date.

  • Updates customer regularly (with frequency, according to standards determined by management).

  • Participates in and contributes to the regularly scheduled production meetings.

  • Calls customers whose cars will be completed the next day. Schedules with customer.

  • Follow up with technicians after vehicle tear down and make adjustments to estimate if needed.

  • Assist insurance adjusters with damage reports, etc., and provide service to insurance claim re-inspectors.

Education and/or Experience Required

  • High school diploma/GED required.

  • Prior customer service experience.

  • Must currently possess or successfully complete 16 I-CAR units within the first 12 months of employment.

  • Preferred: 4-6 years related work experience. Photo-imaging software experience preferred.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Computer literate. Knowledge of Microsoft products is preferred.

  • Good decision-making ability and sound judgment.

Other Requirements ​

  • Must be able to walk, stand, stoop, kneel and crouch in providing an accurate estimate of a vehicle’s damage.

  • Must possess clear vision in providing an accurate estimate of a vehicle’s damage.

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The physical demands of your job must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the job.

    • Annual Paid Time Off (PTO) plans

    • 2 weeks of Paid Parental Leave for Full time Employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week

    • 6 paid holidays annually

    • Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental & Vision Insurance effective Day 1

    • 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match

    • Employer Paid Short-Term Disability & Life Insurance

    • Additional Voluntary Life Insurance

    • Continuing Education Opportunities

    • Free Prescription or Non-Prescription Safety Glasses annually

    • Annual Voluntary Uniform Stipend

    • Voluntary Daily Pay option available

    Gerber Collision & Glass has been WOWing customers with our collision repair services for over 80 years. Please visit to learn more about our company.

Job Description:

Opportunity

Are you a strategic finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment? Join Hitachi Energy as a Campus Controller and play a critical role in shaping business performance, driving profitability, and supporting operational excellence.

In this position, you will serve as a trusted business partner, providing financial leadership and insight to help guide key decisions across the organization. You will oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, compliance, risk management, and performance analysis while collaborating closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, HR, and Commercial teams.

This is an opportunity to influence business outcomes by transforming financial data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement initiatives, optimizing costs, enhancing working capital performance, and supporting sustainable growth. You will help create value by balancing strategic thinking with operational execution, ensuring financial integrity and supporting the achievement of business objectives.

If you are passionate about leadership, continuous improvement, and making a measurable impact through finance, we invite you to join a global organization that is advancing a sustainable energy future.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Provide financial guidance and business insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Strong knowledge of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and financial reporting processes.

  • Experience with internal controls, risk management, compliance requirements, and audit support activities.

  • Proven ability to analyze complex financial data and translate insights into business recommendations.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decision-making across functions.

title: Administrator
description:
Requirements

Complete the requirements for Administrator Licensure for Assisted Living in the state of Virginia, including successful completion of the state-regulated exam.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; talk; or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop; kneel; or crouch The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision and depth perception.

Description

  1. Assure that all rights given to residents in the Bill of Rights are insured and that assistance is available to exercise these rights.

  1. Maintain confidentiality regarding each resident and their protected health information.

  1. Make sure that proper documentation and record keeping is performed for all residents and staff members, as well as the operation of the facility.

  1. Maintain annual budget and oversee the financial operations of the business office.

  1. Assure that all food, supplies, and equipment are purchased to meet the needs of each resident.

  1. Help perform functions as representative payee for those residents in need of such services for Social Security benefits.

  1. Develop and implement policies and procedures in all relevant areas in order to ensure the daily operations of the facility occur without delay or difficulty.

  1. Perform pre-admission interviews with a perspective resident, guardian, family member(s), and/or responsible party to determine appropriateness for placement.

  1. Make final determination for admissions and discharges.
  2. Serve as a reference for visitors, family members, vendors, and other outside entities.

  1. Maintain and audit records concerning resident census, and have available a sign-in/sign-out register to account for all residents assigned to the facility.

  1. Provide residents with the opportunity to ask questions and discuss issues regarding their care and financial records.

  1. Ensure that all residents are receiving the level of care that they need, including the transfer to a higher or lower level of care when necessary.

  1. Assess and obtain outside support for residents from others in the community when necessary, including, but not limited to, medical attention, psychiatric services, and rehabilitative programs.

  1. Arrange and/or provide transportation for residents as required.

  1. Ensure proper administration of all medications, treatments, and prescribed programs as ordered by the physician and in accordance with current regulations and guidelines.

  1. Assure provision of required hours of activities per week.

  1. Review the activities program on a bi-annual basis, or as needed otherwise.

  1. Maintain proper records of all resident funds, and account for all documented resident expenses.

  1. Maintain records and notify appropriate parties of all accidents/incidents.

  1. Assist consultants, physicians, and other healthcare providers to assure overall medical care.

  1. Maintain compliance in sanitation, safety requirements, and building code requirements as required by the state regulatory agencies.

  1. Assure all personnel regulations are met including, but not limited to:
    1. Recruiting, interviewing, selecting, training, and delegating responsibilities to all staff to provider proper coverage on a continuous basis.
    2. Maintaining records of employee training and required annual education requirements.
    3. Familiarizing all staff with policies and procedures including, but not limited to, accidents/incidents, fire safety, and emergency procedures.
    4. Assuring that all staff are aware of the Resident’s Bill of Rights and they are able to provide for these rights in their job roles.

  1. Cooperate with and serve as a liaison to all local, regional, and state agencies concerned with licensure and monitoring of Adult Care Homes.

  1. Maintain Administrator’s License and meet the required educational obligations that are of the state regulatory agency’s specifications.

  1. Serve as a facilitator for resident’s council and be available for grievances and complaints filed by residents.

title: Data & Analytics Consultant
description:
*Note* this role is located in Belfast, UK. We are not accepting applications for remote work.


About us

Tiedot is a performance marketing agency specialising in digital advertising, data & analytics. We are based in Belfast, UK. We are helping build the future of digital advertising through strategy, data consultancy and campaign management. Our specialist skills & knowledge help clients adopt the latest innovation in evidence-based marketing.


Founded in 2022 and now in its fifth year in business, our agency is growing as demand for our services has increased. We are looking for a highly capable data & analytics specialist to support our team throughout this growth and beyond. This role is best suited for someone looking to expand their skillset and solve complex challenges. They will report to our Data & Analytics Lead.


Job Overview

Are you an inquisitive person? Do you like to solve complex problems? And do you thrive when presenting your findings to clients? If yes, then this might be the role for you.


We are looking for an experienced data & analytics specialist who has a demonstrable record of improving online marketing performance with data & analytics (especially advertising). They will be tasked with delivering technical solutions in a consultative manner, working closely with external and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate can boil down the complex into clear, easy-to-follow steps; without losing effectiveness in the process.


Our analytics proposition revolves around several core solutions for which we act as a centre of excellence. Those are: Conversion Signal Optimisation, Online Media Optimisation (& Attribution) and Customer Science. We are also developing expertise in Conversion Rate Optimisation. The successful candidate will take ownership of these solutions; delivering them for clients, empowering team members and sharing with prospective collaborators. There will also be significant scope for innovation and solution development.


This will be both challenging and rewarding as the work is cutting-edge. Opportunities to learn new technologies and techniques are available and encouraged. This role is therefore best suited to ambitious candidates.


Key Responsibilities


// Data & Analytics Consultancy

  • Build effective relationships with both clients and team members, maintaining clear communication in a constructive manner;
  • Take a proactive approach to problem solving: identifying relevant solutions, scoping out projects and achieving buy-in from stakeholders;
  • Deliver impactful outcomes; presenting pre- and post- project updates, reports and analyses;
  • Assisting agency Leads with strategic planning, proposals, pitches, etc.


// Solutions Ownership

  • Be primary point of contact for data & analytics solutions, owning documentation and maintenance of best practice;
  • Conduct audits and research, providing in-depth analysis on the state-of-play, plus actionable recommendations;
  • Create impactful reports and presentations, clearly communicating ideas, concepts and results;
  • Improve analytical and/or scientific approach across the agency; sharing hypotheses, testing assumptions and delivering proven outcomes;
  • Train team members and clients in our “Get To Good” best practices;
  • Assist Leads in commercial ownership of projects.


// Data Management & Operations

  • Own end-to-end data management, from source to delivery, including
  • Data collection (Google Tag Manager)
  • Data manipulation and modelling (Funnel.io, Google Sheets)
  • Architecture and storage (BigQuery/SQL)
  • Exploration and analysis (Google Analytics, Google Ads & more)
  • Reports & Visualisation (Looker Studio)
  • Own measurement planning for all clients, maintaining conversion documentation;
  • Manage Conversion Signal Optimisation for advertising clients: identifying measurement gaps, designing and implementing solutions;
  • Own and implement tracking solutions, such as Stape, Conversions API, etc;
  • Adapt automation to improve speed and quality of decision making; e.g. through Zapier, Large Language Models, Context Engineering and more.


// Media Measurement & Optimisation

  • Assist performance (advertising) team in decision making; especially advertising budget utilisation across channels, platforms and more;
  • Assist with identifying and maximising utility of attribution models and other media measurement methods;
  • Assist in report creation and analysis from ad platforms, web analytics and third party technology (e.g. Triplewhale), to inform media channel decisions and in-platform optimisation.


// Analysis & Optimisation

  • Undertake ad-hoc and structured analysis of digital marketing or web data - distill findings to turn insights into actionable recommendations for our clients;
  • Utilise optimisation and experimentation frameworks, such as Conversion Rate Optimisation;
  • Aggregate and assimilate insights from a variety of sources - social media, search engines, CRMs - to develop customer insights and inform segmentation, targeting and positioning (Customer Science).


// Project Management

  • Own multiple live projects at any given time, ensuring deadlines are met and quality is maintained, utilising our project management system (Teamwork);
  • Regularly communicate project status to internal and external stakeholders;
  • Proactively monitor any shortcomings in timings or quality.


// Team Management

  • Although not an initial requirement, this role will be expected to manage junior team members in the future, conducting fortnightly 1-2-1s, 6-monthly reviews and co-owning OKRs;
  • External staff management may also be required in future.


// Contribute towards marketing projects both for the company and clients

  • Input into marketing materials
  • Assist with marketing campaigns


Essential Criteria

  • 4+ years experience working in data & analytics, preferably agency-side;
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager;
  • Highly strategic thinker, proactive, and driven
  • Proven success in Data Visualisation, e.g. Google’s Data Studio;
  • Knowledge and experience of quality assurance for, and testing of, tag implementations.


Desirable Criteria

  • Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms, e.g. Google Ads, Meta Ads, etc.;
  • Experience of CRM platforms, e.g. Hubspot, Salesforce;
  • Experience of marketing automation platforms, e.g. Marketo, Pardot;
  • SQL and using BigQuery plus Google Cloud, or other data warehouse tools;
  • Familiarity with attribution solutions, e.g. Google Ads, Meta Ads, TripleWhale, Northbeam;
  • Knowledge of web development, including the use of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.


What we offer

title: Simulation Technology Operator, Division of Health Sciences
description:
Job Title

Simulation Technology Operator, Division of Health Sciences

Agency

Tarleton State University

Department

Division of Health Sciences

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

Stephenville, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Tarleton State University, a distinguished Doctoral National Comprehensive University, invites applications for the position of Simulation and Technology Operator in the Division of Health Sciences. As part of a vibrant academic community dedicated to excellence in teaching, research, and service, this role offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a university that values innovation, collaboration, and inclusive growth. Join us in advancing knowledge and transforming lives—on campus and beyond. Tarleton State University continues to grow its impact across Texas, with four distinct campuses located in Stephenville, Fort Worth, RELLIS-Bryan and Waco, along with a robust online community that extends our reach even further.

At the heart of it all is Stephenville, where Tarleton State offers a dynamic environment for faculty and staff. From a lively live music scene and numerous local festivals to rich traditions rooted in the surrounding community, Stephenville provides a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere.

No matter where you're located—on campus or online—you are part of a mission that transforms lives and makes a difference across the state of Texas and beyond.

________________________________________________________________________

Important Immigration Information:

A Presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025. Please be advised that Tarleton State University will NOT pay this fee. Therefore, if you need immigration sponsorship for your employment, we recommend that you consult with your private immigration counsel at your own expense to ascertain whether your current immigration status would make a potential offer of employment from Tarleton State University subject to this fee.

In addition, on January 27, 2026, Texas Governor Abbot issued a moratorium on the filing of any new H-1B unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate.

________________________________________________________________________

The Simulation and Technology Operator supports the delivery of simulation-based learning activities within Tarleton’s Clinical Learning Resource sites. This role is responsible for scheduling and coordinating site activities, preparing simulation environments (including moulage and equipment readiness), operating scenarios or skills training as assigned, supporting standardized patient encounters (including digital audio/video recording support), and restoring rooms and equipment to readiness after activities. The Operator also maintains supply readiness and provides routine simulation equipment support.

This is a 12-month staff position located on Tarleton’s main campus in Stephenville, Texas. Work hours: Mon-Fri; 8 AM-5 PM or as work requirements indicate. Position may require work responsibilities outside of normal business hours. Travel between university simulation sites will be necessary. Serves as a Campus Security Authority (CSA). This position reports directly to the Division of Health Science Simulation Operations and Technology Director.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare simulation rooms, equipment, and materials for scheduled learning activities, including staging simulation environments to reflect clinical or instructional scenarios (room setup, equipment placement, and basic props).

  • Operate simulation equipment during sessions (including mannequins, control systems, and related tools) using established scenarios.

  • Support faculty and facilitators during live simulations to ensure sessions run smoothly, and provide on-site support to address immediate needs.

  • Reset simulation rooms and return equipment to readiness between sessions, ensuring continuity and consistency for subsequent activities.

  • Assist with scenario setup and execution as directed by faculty or simulation leadership.

  • Maintain organization of supplies, materials, and simulation spaces, and coordinate with faculty and simulation leadership on day-of-session needs and requirements.

  • Ensure materials and environments are prepared according to the simulation schedule and assist with day-to-day simulation site workflows and readiness checks.

  • Assist with standardized patient program activities, including recruiting coordination, training support, scheduling support, and collecting participant readiness/evaluation information as assigned.

  • Support patient encounters, including digital audio/video recording setup/support, support for student debriefings, and submission/collection of evaluations as assigned.

  • Perform routine setup, basic operation, and basic upkeep of simulation equipment and tools, including maintaining and restocking supplies and supply rooms to support scheduled activities.

  • Identify and report equipment or technology issues to the appropriate team (simulation leadership and/or OITS as directed) and escalate advanced repair needs rather than performing complex repairs.

  • Provide basic guidance on the use of simulation tools and environments while maintaining a professional, organized, and supportive learning environment.

  • Follow established procedures for simulation setup, execution, and reset, and assist with documenting workflows, room setups, and standard practices.

Minimum Requirements

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 3 years of experience supporting faculty in the operation of skills assessment technologies; Professional work experience with simulation-related programs and technology, particularly those technologies that are immersive, hands-on and provide an environment that emulates the space in which learners will serve for their careers.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Working knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and basic database applications (e.g., for schedules, tracking, documentation, and reporting).

  • Strong interpersonal and professional communication skills for effective collaboration with faculty, staff, learners, and patients.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills with the ability to prepare rooms and materials efficiently.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage competing deadlines while supporting live simulation activities.

  • Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing to support operational coordination and documentation.

  • Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment across multiple areas/locations as needed.

  • Basic understanding of clinical simulation methodologies and audio/visual technologies (including digital recording support).

  • Ability to operate standard office equipment (computer systems, printers, telephones, and related tools).

  • Ability to follow defined processes and contribute to continuous improvement through feedback.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: Commensurate with experience

Salary Range:

The target base annual salary range is $59,370 up to $65,307 and may be negotiable based on funding availability and candidate experience/skillset in relation to the minimum requirements of this position.

We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time and qualifying part-time employees. Our Careers Page offers an overview of the great benefits we offer; for detailed information visit our Benefits Information page.

Qualified candidates are encouraged to submit a completed application for consideration. Initial review of applications will begin immediately and continue until position is filled.

Application Procedure:

During the application process applicants have one opportunity to enter the requested information, upload documents and Submit the application. Applicants will not be able to make changes or add additional documents once the application materials have been submitted via "Submit" action.

Employment applications must include:

  • Completed online application
  • Cover Letter / Letter of Interest addressing qualifications
  • Curriculum Vitae or Resume
  • At least 3 current professional references and their full contact information

Applications received by Tarleton State University must have all job application data entered. Failure to provide all job application data could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. “See resume” is not an acceptable entry in the job application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

title: Senior PHP Developer, Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are looking for a PHP Developer to join the vulnerability remediation program of one of our clients. Their security scanning tooling is surfacing more findings than the internal team can close — your job is to close that gap. This is not advisory work and it is not a pure security analyst role: you will spend your days in the PHP codebase and in AWS, implementing fixes, validating closures, and driving remediation throughput at scale. The ideal candidate has worked extensively with PHP and has hands-on experience remediating security vulnerabilities, not just identifying them.

What You Will Do

  • Take prioritized findings from the security backlog and drive each one to deployed, validated completion — researching root cause, implementing the correct fix, deploying it, and producing closure evidence for the client's risk program.
  • Remediate PHP vulnerabilities hands-on: fix injection, authentication, deserialization, and credential exposure defects; refactor vulnerable patterns; and remove hardcoded secrets.
  • Perform dependency and package upgrades using Composer, resolving breaking changes and transitive conflicts.
  • Execute AWS-side remediation: configuration hardening, IAM adjustments, and secret rotation — migrating credentials to a managed secrets store in coordination with the Remediation Lead.
  • Validate every fix through automated tests and confirm the finding no longer reproduces.
  • Identify recurring patterns that warrant a systemic fix rather than repeated one-off remediation, and contribute them to the team playbook.
  • Work embedded with the client's engineering team, following their branching, code review, CI/CD, and definition of done.
  • Support client engineers in adopting secure coding practices.

What We Require

  • Professional PHP development experience — including work on legacy or inherited codebases. Recent, active PHP work is required;
  • Hands-on security remediation experience — you must have personally fixed OWASP Top 10 class vulnerabilities at code level. Understanding them conceptually is not enough.
  • Excellent English communication skills — daily written and spoken collaboration with a US-based engineering team.
  • Senior or above seniority level
  • Experience writing automated tests with PHPUnit or equivalent.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with Git, code review discipline, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working with security scanners at volume: Snyk, Veracode, Dependabot, or Checkmarx.
  • Prior experience burning down a security or technical debt backlog against throughput targets.
  • Modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony) alongside legacy pre-framework PHP.
  • AWS experience specifically with PHP applications: EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, or Parameter Store.
  • Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Containerization with Docker and ECS or EKS.
  • Experience integrating with legacy systems

Our benefits:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and food allowance
  • Childcare assistance
  • Extended paternity leave

title: Applications Analyst - Epic Research & Dorothy (Salaried, Full time)
location: Washington Regional Med. Ctr. - Fayetteville, AR 72703
description:
Organization Overview, Mission, Vision, and Values

Our mission is to improve the health of people in the communities we serve through compassionate, high-quality care, prevention, and wellness education. Washington Regional Medical System is a community-owned, locally governed, non-profit health care system located in Northwest Arkansas in the heart of Fayetteville, which is consistently ranked among the Best Places to live in the country. Our 425-bed medical center has been named the #1 hospital in Arkansas for five consecutive years by U.S. News & World Report. We employ 3,200+ team members and serve the region with over 40 clinic locations, the region’s only Level II trauma center, and five Centers of Excellence - the Washington Regional J.B. Hunt Transport Services Neuroscience Institute; Washington Regional Walker Heart Institute; Washington Regional Women and Infants Center; Washington Regional Total Joint Center; and Washington Regional Pat Walker Center for Seniors.

Position Summary

The Applications Analyst – Epic Research & Dorothy reports to the Assistant Manager, Epic Applications. This position is responsible for advanced support, troubleshooting, maintenance, design, build, testing, implementation, and optimization of Epic Research, Epic Dorothy, and related applications supporting clinical research and home-based care. The role partners with research investigators, study coordinators, clinicians, home health leaders, field-based caregivers, revenue cycle, compliance, information services, and Epic/vendor stakeholders to support secure, efficient, compliant, and patient-centered workflows. Key areas of responsibility include research study records, clinical trial enrollment and documentation, study calendars and questionnaires, research billing dependencies, home health episodes, scheduling, care plans, clinical documentation, mobile workflows, orders, regulatory requirements, reporting, application reliability, and cross-application integration.

Essential Position Responsibilities

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of Epic Research and Epic Dorothy functionality, including research study records, participant enrollment, clinical trial documentation, study calendars, questionnaires, reporting, home health episodes, scheduling, care plans, orders, clinical documentation, mobile workflows, billing dependencies, interfaces, and downstream impacts across the enterprise
  • Lead research, home health, clinical, operational, compliance, revenue cycle, internal information services, and Epic/vendor partners in developing enhancements, optimization initiatives, and workflow improvement projects for Epic Research and Dorothy
  • Oversee Epic Research and Dorothy application design, build, configuration, maintenance, and validation to ensure functionality aligns with research operations, home health care delivery, patient safety, regulatory, revenue cycle, and end-user requirements
  • Perform complex analysis, build, implementation, and optimization of workflows supporting research study intake, participant identification and enrollment, clinical trial documentation, study calendars, questionnaires, home health referral and intake, episode management, scheduling, care planning, field documentation, orders, and interdisciplinary coordination
  • Configure and maintain research study records, recruitment tools, documentation templates, SmartTools, questionnaires, reporting requirements, home health Navigators, flowsheets, visit and scheduling workflows, care plans, order preferences, and related application records in accordance with approved governance and change-control processes
  • Meet regularly with investigators, research coordinators, clinical leaders, home health clinicians, field-based caregivers, compliance, privacy, revenue cycle, and operational teams to evaluate workflow concerns and identify opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, regulatory compliance, documentation integrity, data quality, and user experience
  • Lead coordinated testing for Epic Research and Dorothy, including unit, regression, system, integrated, interface, research enrollment, clinical documentation, home health scheduling, mobile and field workflows, orders, billing, reporting, and user acceptance testing
  • Serve as an application and workflow resource by translating clinical research, home health, regulatory, operational, and business requirements into reliable system solutions
  • Coordinate interfaces and integrations with clinical trial management, research billing, identity and consent, reporting and analytics, mobile documentation, scheduling, revenue cycle, and other connected clinical and enterprise applications
  • Provide mentorship for team members and assist with analyst training, workflow education, and knowledge transfer, as needed
  • Ensure programs and services support applicable human-subject research, informed-consent, privacy, security, Medicare, payer, home health, quality, Joint Commission, CMS, and organizational governance requirements
  • Ensure the safeguarding of protected health information, research data, participant information, and appropriate application access
  • Maintain accurate application documentation, build records, test scripts, workflow diagrams, issue resolutions, security requirements, and support materials
  • Monitor help desk software for new tickets; troubleshoot complex research and home health application issues; perform root-cause analysis; and document timely, sustainable resolutions
  • Lead Epic Research and Dorothy projects, upgrades, enhancements, optimization efforts, go-live activities, testing, stabilization, and ongoing maintenance initiatives
  • Identify and lead opportunities to standardize and improve research enrollment, documentation, data collection, reporting, home health referral, intake, scheduling, field documentation, care coordination, billing, and compliance workflows through application optimization and process improvement
  • Adhere to all information services policies, procedures, application governance, change-management, and documentation standards
  • Participate in on-call support and lead incident response, issue resolution, and downtime procedures for assigned applications, as needed

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or clinical license, preferred.
  • Licensure and Certifications: Epic Research and Epic Dorothy certification required. Additional Epic certification or proficiency in Ambulatory, Comfort, Home Health Billing, Resolute, Cogito, Clarity, MyChart, or related integrated applications preferred. Clinical or research certification is preferred when applicable to the candidate’s background.
  • Experience: Four to six years of clinical, research, home health, operational, or healthcare applications experience as an applications analyst supporting multiple modules or applications, with direct experience in Epic build, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization strongly preferred. Experience supporting Epic Research and Dorothy workflows is preferred, including research study records, participant enrollment, clinical trial documentation, study calendars, questionnaires, reporting, home health episodes, scheduling, care plans, mobile documentation, orders, billing dependencies, interfaces, and compliance. Strong knowledge of clinical research and home health operations, application dependencies, testing methodologies, integration workflows, change control, privacy and regulatory requirements, and coordination with research, clinical, revenue cycle, compliance, technology, data, reporting, and operational teams is required.

Work Environment: This position will spend 90% of time sitting while performing work in a standard office environment and 10% of time standing and/or walking while pushing, pulling, lifting, and/or carrying up to 50 lbs. This role is considered a remote position with onsite presence as needed.

Notice: This job description is designed to provide an overview of the essential and principal duties and responsibilities of the position. The job description is not designed or intended to cover or set forth a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Washington Regional reserves the right in its absolute discretion to change duties, responsibilities or activities or assign new duties, responsibilities, or activities at any time with or without notice. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

title: Supervisor, Production
description:

Position Summary

title: Civil Site Superintendent
description:
Summary

The Civil Site Development Superintendent will be accountable for the site preparation of a construction project including clearing of land, earthwork, site improvements, proper layout (surveying), building layout etc. This includes field coordination and working closely with the subcontractors to ensure that quality and workmanship meet Benderson standards. The Superintendent will ensure that the work is carried out safely, correctly, within budget, and on schedule.

Principle Responsibilities & Duties

  • Plan, coordinate, and direct efficient use of all labor, equipment, materials, and subcontractors/ material suppliers to achieve the highest quality.
  • Study contract drawings and specifications in detail. Check all dimensions and bring all discrepancies and omissions to the attention of designers and Project Managers.
  • Examine underground aspects in layout of projects, including review of sitework for conflicts with utilities, domestic, fire, water, gas, electrical and septic sewer
  • Provide daily supervision and scheduling for grading, drainage, paving, structures, and other miscellaneous processes.
  • Monitor activities related to site construction, inspection, engineering and redesign of sitework, including those planned and those currently in existence.
  • Meet utility company reps on-site to coordinate utility services.
  • Assist management in the selection of contractors for the right job at the right price.
  • Monitor progress of construction and review schedule status with Project Manager weekly.
  • Inspect subcontractor work to verify quality and conformance to the construction documents. Review the construction drawings, documents, and contract scopes of work.
  • Review, approve and/or dispute T&M sheets daily, as they are turned in by the subcontractors.
  • Expedite material and equipment orders in a timely fashion to ensure “just in time inventory"
  • Coordinate construction activities with tenant representatives to minimize the impact on their operations while obtaining a high degree of construction efficiency
  • Promote and ensure job site safety

Qualifications

  • Must have an active driver's license.
  • Minimum of 5 years experience in the construction industry as a Superintendent.
  • Background in site construction management, Commercial or Retail construction experience highly preferred.
  • Must be willing to drive to job sites within a 1-3 hour radius of Sarasota.
  • Highly motivated, with a demonstrated passion for excellence and taking initiative.
  • Professional with the ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

Physical Requirements

  • Normal dexterity required in construction and office environment including hand-eye coordination, walking, sitting, standing, alertness (attention to detail), computer input, and answering of phones.
  • May require lifting of materials or boxes weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Much sitting and driving for extended periods of time to get to locations, and walking to perform an inspection of locations

title: Construction Scheduling Analyst
description:
Summary

The Construction Schedule Analyst is a foundational role within the Clark Planning & Scheduling Department. This position is designed for a detail-oriented individual who excels at data manipulation and logical problem-solving. You will support the Project Schedulers by managing the flow of data into Primavera P6, using Excel to audit schedule health, and creating reports that track project milestones.

This role is part of a structured career path in construction planning and scheduling. No prior construction experience is required; we provide technical training for Primavera P6 for candidates who demonstrate high-level analytical potential and a "quick-study" approach to new software.

Responsibilities

  • Commit to an accelerated learning path to become a power user in Primavera P6.

  • Work closely with Project Schedulers to explore the nuances of the Critical Path Method (CPM) and how it applies to complex construction sequencing.

  • On Site support of project teams to update schedules, expand activity detail, adjust construction sequencing, and produce internal and contractually required reporting.

  • Data Analysis and Advanced Reporting utilizing Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel, PowerBI and other industry specific tools.

  • Calculate and report on Project Metrics Total Float and Schedule Performance metrics to help the department identify potential bottlenecks.

  • Identify patterns in historical data to help Project Teams predict future project outcomes.

  • Quality Control: Ensure all schedule data adheres to standards for naming conventions, activity coding, and organizational breakdown.

Basic Qualifications

  • Undergraduate or Associates degree in construction management, engineering, data analysis, mathematics, computer science, business, finance, accounting, or a related field

  • Excel Proficiency

  • An innate interest in troubleshooting data discrepancies and finding the "why" behind the numbers.

  • Ability to summarize and communicate complex data findings

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Primavera P6

  • Results Oriented - Experience in using data to anticipate and solve problems, manage risk and analyze business needs to deliver high quality outcomes

  • Self Motivated - Takes initiative and personal responsibility to deliver value and excellence in all that you do

  • Team Player - Builds interpersonal relationships and collaborators with internal team members, trade partners, architects and clients.

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role: Given that a good portion of your day will be spent at a desk, you should be comfortable with prolonged periods of focused work, whether it's collaborating with colleagues, analyzing data, or developing strategies. The role demands effective communication and sharp visual acuity for reviewing complex documents and performing detailed computer work. While there are times for quiet concentration, you'll also be expected to move actively throughout the office and travel occasionally to various locations, including dynamic construction sites, utilizing different modes of transportation. The ability to lift and move objects up to 10 pounds regularly, and up to 25 pounds on occasion (think a box of files or small office equipment), is also required.

Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.

A Drug Free Workplace: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $77,500 - $90,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. https://www.clarkconstruction.com/careers/clark-experience

title: Controller
description:
The Controller will be responsible for overseeing the accounting operations, books, records, financial reporting, and internal controls for a portfolio of companies. This position will ensure accurate and timely financial information, maintain compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax requirements, and provide ownership and management with clear insight into each company’s financial performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the general ledger, books, and records, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and consistently.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and financial statement preparation.
  • Prepare and review balance sheets, income statements, cash flow reports, and other financial reports for each company.
  • Maintain appropriate accounting policies, procedures, schedules, and supporting documentation across all entities.
  • Monitor cash balances, cash flow, intercompany activity, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, and bank reconciliations.
  • Develop and maintain internal controls to safeguard assets, improve accuracy, and reduce financial risk.
  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisors, auditors, banks, insurance providers, and other professional service partners as needed.
  • Support tax filings, annual audits or reviews, business registrations, compliance reporting, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses to help ownership understand financial results and plan for future needs.
  • Identify process improvements, automation opportunities, and accounting system enhancements to improve efficiency and reporting quality.
  • Supervise, train, or coordinate with bookkeeping, accounting, or administrative staff as applicable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • CPA designation preferred but not required.
  • Minimum of 5–8 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably including experience with small businesses, multiple entities, or closely held companies.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, general ledger accounting, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close procedures.
  • Experience managing accounting records for multiple legal entities, business units, or companies strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with accounting software, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools.
  • Experience with payroll, sales tax, income tax support, insurance audits, and banking relationships is a plus.

Skills and Competencies

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple companies, deadlines, priorities, and reporting requirements at the same time.
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain financial results to non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Hands-on approach with willingness to perform detailed accounting work as well as higher-level financial review.
  • Integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of accounting processes from transaction entry through financial reporting.

title: Patient Services Associate
description:

The Patient Service Associate is responsible for providing appropriate patient documentation forms (demographics, financial, insurance, etc…) and information while complying with all confidentiality and HIPAA regulations.   9. Cooperation – Willingness to help others accomplish their objectives.

  11. Reliability – Dependability and trustworthiness.
  12. Perseverance – Steadfast pursuit of job objectives when faced with unexpected obstacles.
  13. Stability – Even temperament. Acceptance of unavoidable tension and pressure.
  14. Alertness – Ability to quickly understand new information and situations.
  15. Professionalism – Professional actions, communications and attitude.
  16. Team work – Ability to work in a team for the betterment of staff, patients, and the Company.
  17. Observance – Observance of Company policies and procedures.
  18. Attendance – Consistent adherence to work schedule.

Job Responsibilities:

  1. While maintaining and following all HIPAA regulations and standards, it is the Patient Service Associate’s responsibility to check in and check out all patients and follow the appropriate procedures and policies concerning necessary documentation and chart preparation.
  2. The Patient Service Associate is responsible for ensuring appropriate customer service, assisting patients in the lobby with various needs. This position is to provide accurate and appropriate information to authorized individuals in a timely and efficient manner.

Spine Team Texas was founded on a team concept approach. To build and enhance the team, each employee must contribute positive interaction, promote value and be a “team-player” not only for their unit or department, but for Spine Team Texas as a whole.

Must be able to sit for long periods of time and work in a well-lit, air conditioned office environment. Must have ability to lift a minimum of 5 pounds. Must be able to work under pressure. Tasks involve no exposure to blood or other potentially infectious materials.

The Project Controls Specialist will support planning, scheduling, cost control, and reporting for balance of plant (BOP) scope across oil & gas and power generation projects.   • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure schedule alignment

Risk & Change Management

  • Track and evaluate change orders and scope growth, assessing schedule and cost impacts

  • Coordinate across multiple workstreams including gas supply, cooling systems, substations, and plant infrastructure

title: AI Solutions Analyst
description:
At doTERRA we encourage all employees to seek out opportunities that will expand their skill set. We strive to help achieve personal career goals by providing opportunities of growth and movement throughout the company.

Job Description

The AI Solutions Analyst I helps build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered data solutions that enable employees to ask business questions and perform ad hoc analysis using natural language.

Working closely with the Data Warehousing team and business stakeholders, this role configures and optimizes AI agents within Snowflake, translates business requirements into effective agent experiences, tests and evaluates agent performance, and improves the quality and usefulness of agent responses over time.

This is an early-career technical analytics role at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and business enablement. Its primary focus is making enterprise AI agents accurate, useful, reliable, governed, and accessible to business users rather than developing production software or owning core data warehouse models.

Work location: This position is based at doTERRA's Pleasant Grove, Utah campus and requires full-time, on-site presence.

Job Responsibilities

AI Agent Development & Configuration

  • Build and configure internal AI agents that help employees interact with approved enterprise data through natural language.
  • Define and refine agent instructions, context, tools, workflows, guardrails, and expected response behaviors.
  • Configure agents to use approved Snowflake data assets, Cortex Analyst semantic views, and other governed resources as appropriate.
  • Create and maintain evaluation sets that include representative questions, expected outcomes, edge cases, and known limitations.
  • Diagnose inaccurate, incomplete, unsupported, or inconsistent responses and iterate on configurations to improve results.
  • Evaluate emerging Snowflake AI and agent capabilities and recommend where they can strengthen doTERRA's internal AI ecosystem.

Agent Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish repeatable methods for evaluating response correctness, relevance, groundedness, consistency, reliability, and usability.
  • Review agent interactions, evaluation results, and user feedback to identify recurring failure patterns and improvement opportunities.
  • Test and document changes to instructions, tools, and configurations before broader deployment.
  • Partner with Data Warehousing team members when agent performance reveals gaps in source data, business definitions, semantic resources, or access patterns.
  • Help develop standards, documentation, and lifecycle practices for creating, releasing, monitoring, and maintaining enterprise AI agents.
  • Follow applicable data governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements, escalating risks or control gaps when identified.

Business Requirements & Solution Design

  • Meet with business leaders and end users to understand common questions, workflows, terminology, metrics, and decision-making needs.
  • Translate business requirements into clear agent use cases, acceptance criteria, representative questions, and expected behaviors.
  • Identify which questions and workflows are appropriate for AI-enabled self-service analytics and clarify boundaries for out-of-scope or higher-risk requests.
  • Work with technical partners to confirm that required data is available, governed, defined consistently, and structured for the intended use case.
  • Validate solutions with business stakeholders and incorporate their feedback into prioritized improvements.

Adoption & Enablement

  • Support the rollout of AI agents across business functions through pilots, demonstrations, training, and practical usage guidance.
  • Help users learn how to ask effective questions, interpret results, and recognize when additional validation is needed.
  • Document agent capabilities, limitations, intended use cases, data coverage, and known behaviors in clear language.
  • Gather structured feedback, maintain an improvement backlog, track adoption, and identify opportunities to reduce manual analysis or improve access to information

Job Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or another related analytical field.
  • Foundational understanding of relational data, databases, metrics, and analytical concepts, with the ability to translate business questions into structured requirements and testable expected outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, AI agents, LLM-based workflows, or related technologies through employment, internships, academic work, or substantial personal projects.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and attention-to-detail skills, together with the curiosity to experiment, test, learn, and iterate.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users.

Preferred

  • Experience with Snowflake and Snowflake Cortex, including Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, or related capabilities.
  • Experience configuring, testing, monitoring, or evaluating AI agents, with familiarity in prompt and instruction design, orchestration, semantic layers or views, or retrieval-based AI systems.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases; familiarity with tools such as Python, Git, or VS Code is a plus.
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Experience designing evaluations or testing the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated results.

Equal Employment Opportunity
